title: fix(plugin-auth)!: a change to a user's credential ends every other outstanding password-reset token of that user
body:
Clause-②: no (narrowing) — every door that sets a user's password ends every other password-reset link and texted reset code still outstanding for that user, in the same request and before the new password is written: a completed reset (`POST /reset-password`, `POST /phone-number/reset-password`), the user's own `POST /change-password`, an administrator's `POST /admin/set-user-password`, and a first password (`POST /set-initial-password`). No request, response or metadata shape is added, removed or re-shaped; a link or code requested after the change resets as usual.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: updated here — `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx` states the rule; no skill under `skills/**` teaches the reset doors.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:用户的密码只要被任一入口改动(完成重置、本人改密、管理员设密、首次设密),该用户此前发出、尚未使用的其他重置链接和短信重置码一律作废;改动之后再申请的链接/验证码照常可用。
- 为什么改:安全加固,规则是「凭据一变,之前的重置凭证全部失效」。
- 风险与回滚:每次写密码多两三次读和少量删除;若作废这一步失败,这次改密直接报错、旧密码保持不变(宁可失败,不留活凭证)。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/credential-change-ends-reset-tokens.ts`(规则与作废逻辑)、`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/objectql-adapter.ts` 中 create / update / updateMany 三处接线(均在写入之前)、`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/credential-change-ends-reset-tokens.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/credential-change-ends-reset-tokens.test.ts`,预期 10/10 通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **The rule** — `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/credential-change-ends-reset-tokens.ts` (new): a change to a user's credential ends every other outstanding password-reset token of that user — the emailed reset links and the texted reset code for the phone number the user holds — and, with a host `secondaryStorage`, their cached copies. An ended token answers exactly what a token never issued answers. A token that cannot be ended aborts the write, so the old password stands.
- **The wiring** — `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/objectql-adapter.ts`: the storage adapter's `create`, `update` and `updateMany` call the rule for every `sys_account` write that carries `password`, before the write lands. Every password door crosses this one seam with the user in hand, the administrator's door (which runs outside any endpoint context) included.
- **Docs** — `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx` states the rule beside the reset section.
- **Census** — the tenant-audit census page and its ledger are regenerated for the one new engine write site (`node scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs --write`), with the page's prose figures moved to match (322 → 323 and the counts derived from it).
- **Changeset** — `@objectstack/plugin-auth` patch, BREAKING narrowing, ADR-0087 `not-required`.

The eight plugin-auth files held by #34333 are untouched.

## Tests

`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/credential-change-ends-reset-tokens.test.ts` — every door through the real routes (a real `AuthManager` over a real `ObjectQL` engine on better-sqlite3, behind `AuthPlugin.registerAuthRoutes` on a Hono app):

- a completed reset ends the user's other reset links, whichever was spent first; the ended link answers what a never-issued link answers, at `POST /reset-password` and at its landing (`GET /reset-password/:token`); the password is the one the spent link set;
- `POST /change-password`, `POST /admin/set-user-password` and `POST /set-initial-password` each end every link outstanding before them; a link requested afterwards resets (the control);
- a password change ends the outstanding texted reset code (it answers what a never-sent code answers); a code requested afterwards resets; a completed texted-code reset ends the outstanding links;
- another user's links are untouched (the control);
- with a `secondaryStorage` cache, the ended link's cached copy is gone and the link answers what a never-issued link answers;
- a password write whose tokens cannot be ended does not land: the old password stands and the outstanding link resets.

## Acceptance notes

- The legacy `createObjectQLAdapter` export (raw, without the factory) is not wired; `AuthManager` composes only `createObjectQLAdapterFactory`, and the legacy export already carries none of the factory's other seams.
